scientific_question: Are held-out Riesz-action targets locally identifiable from the existing deployment-visible observation and reported-geometry features, or does the v143 failure persist even under a fixed nonlinear neighborhood rule?
reason_for_new_gate: v143 independently closed the shared-linear Riesz-action hypothesis while its oracle inverse passed. Before any nonlinear model or GPU rental, v144 tests whether nearby deployment-visible inputs carry locally consistent targets at all.

immutable_roster.sentinel_indices: reuse the frozen v143 one-per-trajectory-by-camera-count roster
immutable_roster.teacher_target: validated v143 geometry-local block Riesz action

direction_roster.pair_keys: 2 detector components x 6 depth anchors x 2 signed branches

deployment_visible_metric.base_design: the same 155-dimensional target-camera, peer-camera, pooled-camera, direction-observable and discrete-token design as v143
deployment_visible_metric.base_normalization: reuse each v143 complete-trajectory fold's fit-only normalization
deployment_visible_metric.local_whitening: per outer fold and structural key, mean and population standard deviation from the cross-trajectory candidate reservoir only
deployment_visible_metric.distance: root mean squared Euclidean distance over active whitened dimensions
deployment_visible_metric.camera_permutation_rule: numeric camera IDs are absent; target, peer and pooled camera features co-permute with direction tokens

candidate_rosters.within_selector: minimum SHA256(namespace|query_sample_index|sample_index) among the other 739 samples in the same trajectory

fixed_predictors.cheap_control: cross-trajectory candidate-label mean per structural key

decision_rule.cross_knn_all_20_and_mean_control_fails: Authorize only a separately frozen minimal nonlinear CPU sentinel. GPU rental, physical replay, resource testing and external testing remain unauthorized.
decision_rule.mean_control_all_20: Prefer the cheaper fixed mean control and do not authorize a nonlinear model.
decision_rule.within_knn_fails: Close local identifiability under the frozen 155-dimensional metric and direction sampling; do not rescue with a larger model.
decision_rule.within_knn_passes_but_cross_knn_fails: Record cross-trajectory local-transfer failure under the frozen metric; do not rescue with a larger model.
decision_rule.execution_or_independent_recomputation_f: Inconclusive; preserve evidence and do not interpret partial arrays.
